column1: # Resolved JSON keys for /mirage/GetInfo, per native parser.
# (which are themselves outputs of ResolvePcRelativeStrings.java against the
# relocated string pool). `so_addr` is the literal's address in the .so.
# "n" at 0x1d6f95a: the literal pool overlaps the tail of the previous string
# ("hp_percent" ends at 0x1d6f95c in the same pool), so the single-byte read
# is either a genuine 1-char key or a suffix fragment. analysis/
# ghidra-mirage-strings-11.txt records the same slot also decoding as
# "n_ref_id"/"f_id", which is a pointer-arithmetic artefact, not two more
# keys. Treat the key set of Parse_InstEnemy as {ref_id, rank, rank_up_cnt,
# overcome_cnt, exp, skill_1_level..skill_5_level} and treat "n" as UNKNOWN.
